_note: Agents may only change the 'passes' field. Work through features in order.

features.title: Models and profit target rule (R3)
acceptance: Models reject naive datetimes and unsorted snapshots
Profit target uses balance, not equity
No snapshots gives PENDING

features.title: Max daily loss rule (R1)
acceptance: No breach gives PASSED
Equity strictly below the daily limit gives FAILED with breached_at
Equity exactly at the limit is allowed
Day-start balance carries over from the previous day's last snapshot
Trading days are split at midnight in config.timezone, not UTC

features.title: Max loss rule (R2)
acceptance: No breach gives PASSED
Equity strictly below the overall limit gives FAILED with the first breach time
Equity exactly at the limit is allowed

features.title: Minimum trading days rule (R4)
acceptance: Days are counted by trade open time in config.timezone
Several trades on one day count once
A trade opened late in the evening UTC can fall on the next local day

features.title: Overall verdict (evaluate)
acceptance: Returns rule results in order R1-R4
FAILED with the earliest breach time when several rules failed
PASSED only when every rule passed
IN_PROGRESS otherwise

features.title: CLI: evaluate an account from a JSON file
acceptance: python -m challenge_engine account.json prints the verdict and each rule's detail
Exit code 0 for PASSED or IN_PROGRESS, 1 for FAILED, 2 for invalid input
Invalid input prints a clear error, not a traceback
